info.name: Image Extraction Local API
info.description:
Local Postman collection for the image extraction API.

Prerequisites:
1) Start backend locally: npm run start --prefix backend
2) Set collection variables: api_key, template_id, and optionally workspace_id
3) Use a valid PNG/JPEG/WEBP/PDF file for upload

Auth for all /v1 extraction endpoints uses Bearer API key.

request.description:
Creates a template. Do not provide field IDs or object column keys; the API derives field IDs from field name and object column keys from column heading.

Expected: HTTP 201 with { template_id, version, status }.

Updates a template. Do not provide field IDs or object column keys; the API derives field IDs from field name and object column keys from column heading.

Expected: HTTP 200 with { template_id, version, status }.

Uploads a document and queues an extraction job.

Expected: HTTP 202 with { job_id, status: "queued" }.

Checks current status for a job id.

Poll until status becomes completed, failed, or retryable_failed.

Returns extracted field results when the job is completed.

If status is not completed yet, this endpoint returns job metadata without results.
